info.title: Janzeer Node API
info.description: REST API of a Janzeer node (base path `/api/v1/`). Every response body is the envelope `{timestamp, version, payload}` (`version` = API version 1.1.0); errors carry `payload: {status, message, type?}`. Transactions are signed client-side and POSTed; the node never holds keys. JSON-RPC 2.0 is also served at `POST /rpc` and `ws://…/rpc/ws` (not part of this document — see the developer guide §2.14). Official SDKs: @janzeer/sdk (npm), janzeer_sdk (pub.dev), org.janzeer:janzeer-sdk (Maven).
